item.title: Official entry info for Moldova was updated (Nov 4, 2026)
item.description: UK government note: "This travel advice has been reviewed for accuracy with changes made throughout, including updated information about visa requirements, land border crossings, entering Moldova from Ukraine, political situation, humanitarian support workers, crime, using cameras, money and taxi's ('Entry requirements' and 'Safety and security' pages)." Updates like this can affect other passports too, so check the official entry rules for your passport before you book or travel. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.
